features.title: List my cloud sessions
features.description: Show titles, IDs, recent activity, and links. Verify pagination rather than assume the 20-item picker is complete.

features.title: Select a session by spoken name
features.description: Resolve names and partial names. Ask when more than one session matches.

features.title: Keep a selected session
features.description: Use the same session for follow-ups such as "ask it why" until I switch sessions.

features.title: Limit proactive scans to PM sessions
features.description: Match PM as a separate word, ignoring capitalization. Manual requests can still target other sessions.

features.title: Include or exclude individual sessions
features.description: Allow exceptions to the PM filter and remember them.

features.title: Use Luna agents to read responses
features.description: Retrieve session history without sending a new prompt. Read in an isolated temporary checkout.

features.title: Read only what changed
features.description: Track the last response read and distinguish new output from older conversation history.

features.title: Read an exact response on request
features.description: Return the original wording when I say "read it exactly".

features.title: Report whether work is still running
features.description: Distinguish ongoing work, completion, failure, and waiting for input. Mark unclear states as uncertain.

features.title: Read several sessions in parallel
features.description: Use multiple Luna agents for independent sessions within available concurrency limits.

features.title: Use Luna agents to send messages
features.description: Send through claude -p "message" --cloud <session-id> and verify the CLI delivery result.

features.title: Keep dictated messages exact
features.description: When I say "say" or "send this exactly", preserve the message without adding instructions.

features.title: Turn my intent into a clear instruction
features.description: When I ask you to formulate and send, write a concise instruction using the current context.

features.title: Preview formulated messages before sending
features.description: Show or read the wording and wait for my approval. Literal, explicitly requested sends can proceed immediately.
features.notes: Preview support is optional. Default preview is off.

features.title: Send an instruction to multiple sessions
features.description: Only when I explicitly name the sessions or clearly specify the target group.

features.title: Check for the response after sending
features.description: Check within a bounded period. Report "still working" if no response is ready; avoid an endless polling loop.

features.title: Let the main assistant interpret the results
features.description: Luna retrieves and sends. The main assistant evaluates findings, tradeoffs, and next steps.

features.title: Give short spoken briefings
features.description: Lead with what needs my attention. Offer details when I ask.

features.title: Recommend a reply
features.description: Explain what I should tell a session and why, without sending it automatically.

features.title: Support natural voice follow-ups
features.description: Understand "tell it to proceed", "read the latest", and "use your recommendation" using the selected session.

features.title: Compare work across sessions
features.description: Spot duplicated work, conflicting plans, and dependencies using retrieved evidence.

features.title: Automatically answer within rules I define
features.description: Potential later phase: send replies without a fresh instruction only for explicitly approved rules. Define rules in notes.

features.title: Scan three times a day
features.description: Run scheduled checks of matching PM sessions. Must first verify scheduled access to the authenticated CLI and Luna agents.
features.notes: Validate secure persistence of normal Claude account login across fresh cloud runtimes. Base64 is not encryption, and model-only setup tokens are not a proven relay credential.

features.title: Find sessions waiting for me
features.description: Look for a current unanswered question, a request for approval, or a blocker requiring my decision. Idle alone is not enough.
features.notes: Discover Remote Control sessions on authorized PCs where available; validate transcript and messaging access independently before claiming support.

features.title: Give one combined briefing
features.description: Include each waiting session, its question, a link, and a recommended next action.

features.title: Stay quiet when nothing needs attention
features.description: Skip routine notifications when there are no new actionable items.

features.title: Avoid repeat alerts
features.description: Remember the question already reported. Alert again only when it changes or my chosen reminder interval expires.

features.title: Prioritize urgent decisions
features.description: Put explicit blockers and time-sensitive decisions first. Label inferred urgency as uncertain.

features.title: Run a scan whenever I ask
features.description: Support "what is waiting for me?" independently of scheduled checks.

features.title: Snooze a session or question
features.description: Pause reminders until a chosen time without altering the Claude session.

features.title: Remember IDs and read/send checkpoints
features.description: Persist selected sessions, last confirmed sends, read checkpoints, filters, and notification history.

features.title: Prevent duplicate messages
features.description: After uncertain delivery, inspect evidence before retrying. Do not assume a failed local command means nothing was sent.

features.title: Include evidence and session links
features.description: Tie summaries to the retrieved response and show when it was checked.

features.title: Report access and authentication failures
features.description: Explain login expiry, archived sessions, unavailable features, and incomplete scans instead of claiming success.

features.title: Bound scan time and agent usage
features.description: Limit concurrency, transcript size, polling, and run duration. Report any sessions left unchecked.

features.title: Test a scheduled run before activating scans
features.description: Verify credentials, environment availability, Luna delegation, state persistence, and delivery to the intended conversation.

features.title: Use this JSON as the implementation spec
features.description: Keep every choice and note, including unanswered features, so we can build the skill from my decisions.

policy_resolutions.preview_drafts: Supported, default off; explicit preview requests wait for approval.
policy_resolutions.approved_autoreply: Supported only with explicit user-defined rules; the portable rules list is empty.
policy_resolutions.json_roundtrip: Unresolved user choice; format support is documented but no automatic export of private preferences is enabled.
policy_resolutions.worker_model: Prefer the newest officially verified Luna-family model supported by the host. Search OpenAI official sources with the actual current month and year; do not pin a generation.
